summary.headline: Planetary and Cosmic Significations
summary.text: Catalog entries for a Florentine astrological codex covering lots, planetary years and restitutions, cosmic weather omens, planetary significations in the zodiacal signs, and the natural properties of wandering and fixed stars. Cross-references cite Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos and Hephaestion of Thebes, with additional references to codices 7 and 8.
